name: start_test_run
description: Create an isolated run owned by this credential, bound to an Environment name (defaults to the active environment without changing it). Returns instructions for both header and prefix routing.

name: list_test_runs
description: Recover your own active or finished runs after a client restart. Does not expose another credential or ordinary dashboard mocks.

name: create_mock
description: Atomically create one run-owned request and 1–50 responses. Omit selection fields for Weighted; Sequence uses zero-based order and an exhaustion policy; Rule requires exactly one fallback. Provide curl OR structured request. Idempotency key required; same-run canonical duplicates return CONFLICT with the existing ID. No scripts execute.

fault_type.description: Existing primary-response fault. Timeout approximates a timeout with bounded delay; connection_reset is unsupported.

name: list_mocks
description: Paginate mocks in your own run only. Optional name, method and path filters. Ordinary dashboard mocks are outside P0 access.

name: get_mock
description: Read full run mock configuration, response summaries and current configuration version. Secrets are redacted and text is bounded; never echo redactions back as updates.

name: validate_mock
description: Validate proposed configuration without saving or advancing runtime state. Supply configuration OR the same changes patch used by update_mock (requires run_id/mock_id). Validates the final response pool with the shared dashboard selection validator.

fault_type.description: Existing primary-response fault. Timeout approximates a timeout with bounded delay; connection_reset is unsupported.

name: update_mock
description: Patch endpoint fields and add/update/remove individual responses atomically. Omitted fields are preserved. Supply the version returned by get_mock; stale versions return CONFLICT. Supports Weighted, Sequence and Rule selection; validates the final pool atomically, including fallback swaps.

name: get_mock_url
description: Return both callable routing forms and POSIX example curls. Header routing keeps the path; prefix routing needs no injected header. Replace the origin with the reachable service address from your application.

name: preview_template
description: Render a sample from a raw template OR an owned mock_id + response_id in Template mode. Always read permission only. Uses the run-bound Environment, dashboard validation/Faker catalog and synthetic request/path samples. Seed is an integer or random (default); referenced locale defaults to its response. Never saves preview/configuration/call state, audit rows or credential timestamps. Secret environment previews stay hidden.

name: peek_next_response
description: Read the next configured Sequence response and current run/environment cursor without consuming it or creating call state. Honors Repeat last, Loop and Not found. Other modes explicitly return not applicable; templates and callbacks are not executed.

name: explain_match
description: Diagnose a curl OR retained unmatched log_entry_id using the real scoped matcher, with field comparisons and exclusions, without selecting a response, counters or callbacks. Sensitive values are never returned.

name: get_unmatched_requests
description: Read recent owned-run unmatched request IDs for explain_match. Retention is at most 20 entries and 24 hours, not complete history. Payload evidence stays encrypted server-side.

name: get_calls
description: Read exact since-reset counters and at most 20 retained call digests for one owned mock. Every result states how much evidence is absent; this does not change counters.

name: assert_calls
description: Assert exact unfiltered counts or existing header/query/JSON predicate grammar. Returns ASSERTION_FAILED for definite failure, INCONCLUSIVE_EVIDENCE when retained evidence cannot establish the result. Always includes a CI-readable message.

name: reset_test_run
description: Reset only this active owned run’s counters, sequence positions and verification evidence. Preserve all mock configuration; record the reset in run history. Requires cleanup permission.

name: finish_test_run
description: Finish your run with delete_mocks or keep_mocks. Deletion affects only this run. Repeating finish returns the original final summary and never performs additional cleanup. Requires cleanup permission.
